params.prompt:
Image 1 is the scene. Keep it exactly as it is — same camera, same framing, same young man in the chair, same desk, monitors, bell and every other fixture, same paper and palette.

Change ONE thing: the tall thin patterned tube standing on the tripod at the right of frame is now a confetti cannon: a short, fat barrel shaped like a stubby mortar, about twice as wide as the old tube and half as long, with a wide flared open muzzle angled up towards the desk, painted in cheerful party stripes with a few small confetti shapes, standing on the same squat tripod in the same spot, with a pull-cord ring dangling from its base. It is loaded and quiet.

Hand-drawn animation pencil test: graphite line, visible construction lines, cross-hatch shadow, light coloured-pencil wash on props only, paper tooth showing — no flat vector fill, no digital gradients, no painterly rendering, no photographic lighting, no 3D. Do not add any text.
